title: Naturality of objectwise strict-system scalar compatibility
statement:
For an integral open operation o on j:U→X, there is an isomorphism of cochain-complex functors
(systemExtension l E j o).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ forgetSystems l E X ≅
forgetSystems l E U ⋙ extendTower l E j o.

source.place: Tags 03DI, 03DJ and 0941; identity on strict extension summands and system assembly.

proof.text: Construct the identity comparison on each extension-by-zero summand and pass through coefficient evaluation and sheafification.

lean.statement:
theorem openQuotientScalarSystemsNaturality
    (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E j)
    (α : ∀ C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E U) ℤ,
      ((IntegralOpenReduction.systemExtension l E j o).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
          forgetSystems l E X).obj C ≅
        (forgetSystems l E U ⋙ extendTower l E j o).obj C) :
    ∀ {C D : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E U) ℤ} (f : C ⟶ D),
      (((IntegralOpenReduction.systemExtension l E j o).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
          forgetSystems l E X).map f) ≫ (α D).hom =
        (α C).hom ≫ ((forgetSystems l E U ⋙ extendTower l E j o).map f)
